description: Area-based MEA manufacturing (non-consumable) cost scenarios. Derived from the published per-area totals and consumable shares of a bottom-up SEMI E35 cost-of-ownership study of CCM/MEA production at Fraunhofer ISE. Consumables (catalyst powder, ionomer, membrane, GDL, sub-gasket) are excluded here because COMET prices them separately as materials; what remains is equipment, labor and facility.
source: Hog et al., Techno-Economic Assessment of Manufacturing Membrane Electrode Assemblies for PEM Fuel Cells: Focus on Coating Technologies, Fuel Cells (2026)

currency_conversion.note: Paper expresses all costs in 2025 euros; converted once at the annual average. No inflation adjustment applied - values are stated in 2025 USD.

derivation: manufacturing_usd_per_m2 = total_eur_per_m2_active * (1 - consumable_share) * eur_to_usd. Total and consumable share are stated in the paper's own text for each scenario (MEA7L, per m2 of active area).
limitations: Two published operating points only; the paper does not provide a continuous scale curve, so intermediate production volumes are not interpolated. Figures are for PEM fuel cell MEA7L production (ink mixing through assembly) and are applied per cm2 of active area.
